process: president directly elected by preferential majority popular vote for a 5-year term (eligible for a second term); prime minister appointed by the president
results: 2024: Anura Kumara DISSANAYAKE elected president; percent of vote after reallocation - Anura Kumara DISSANAYAKE (JVP) 55.9%, Sajith PREMADASA (SJB) 44.1%
cabinet: Cabinet appointed by the president in consultation with the prime minister
